description: Single compact fantasy RPG skill icon, crisp 16-bit pixel art, bold clean dark outline, 3 shades per color, simple readable silhouette, centered with 5 pixel empty margin, no frame, no letters, transparent background. Regeneration skill: one bright green sprout with TWO broad green leaves above a small crimson red heart, leaves occupy upper half and heart lower half. Simple compact symbol of renewed health. Green dominant, red accent.
